description: If you remember this video in 2026, you will have a "The Simpsons deja vu".Due to the calculations we made with my colleagues, the climate changes that will occur in x < 3 years will affect the weaker human body way easier & since your skin is the outermost organ of your body, it will be the first one affected.  The expected symptoms include: Photoaging: Skin color changes Solar lentigo: Tan or brown spots on sun-exposed parts of body, especially backs of hands Premature wrinkles ,loose & irregular skin, pre-cancer skin Actinic keratosis: Rough, sandpaper-like, scaly skin spots that can later turn into skin cancer. Skin cancer: Basal cell carcinoma The most common form of skin cancer. Spreading (metastasizing) to other parts of the body is very unlikely.Best treated when detected early.  Squamous cell carcinoma: The next most common form of skin cancer. Spreading (metastasizing) to other parts of the body is also very unusual.  Malignant melanoma The life-threatening form of “black mole” skin cancer. High likelihood of spreading to other parts of body if not treated early. Often causes death if treatment is delayed. It's really scary to think about what's going to happen...🥲 #2026 #climatechange #globalwarming #spf #uvrays #uvray #sunexposure #uvexposure #sundamage #sunburnt #sunburn #skindamage #dryscalp #dryskin #prematureaging #pimple #acne #acnetreatment #skincare #summerskin #summerskincare #summerskincareroutine #for #foryou #foryourpage #foryoupage #fyp
